pages.title: A Garden Below
pages.text: Caring for cave plants creates a renewable material source.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Grottoceratops eats Curly Fern and yields Fiddlehead; Tree Stars breed it. Process Guano into Fertilizer for plants including Thornwood. Charcoal can decorate smooth limestone.
